title: A non-orderable overtwisted contact structure on the sphere
summary: We show that the overtwisted contact structure on $S^3$ with Hopf invariant $-1$ is non-orderable, i.e., that it admits a contractible positive loop of contactopmorphisms. This provides the first known example of a non-orderable overtwisted contact manifold. We further show the existence of a contactomorphism without translated points.
